# CWE-250: Execution with Unnecessary Privileges — Detection in IaC Scripts

## Core Weaknesses to Detect

---

### 1. Over-Privileged Identity & Access Policies
**Description:** Roles, users, or service accounts are granted more permissions than required, violating the principle of least privilege.

| Keywords / Attributes / Fields | Implication |
|---|---|
| `Action: "*"` / `actions: ["*"]` | Wildcard action grants all permissions |
| `Resource: "*"` / `resources: ["*"]` | Applies permissions to all resources |
| `Effect: Allow` combined with wildcards | Blanket allow policy |
| `AdministratorAccess`, `FullAccess`, `PowerUser` | Predefined over-privileged managed policies |
| `iam:PassRole`, `sts:AssumeRole` (unrestricted) | Allows privilege escalation |
| `Principal: "*"` | Grants access to any identity |

---

### 2. Privileged Container Execution
**Description:** Containers are configured to run with elevated OS-level privileges beyond what is operationally needed.

| Keywords / Attributes / Fields | Implication |
|---|---|
| `privileged: true` | Full host kernel access granted to container |
| `allowPrivilegeEscalation: true` | Permits child processes to gain more privileges |
| `readOnlyRootFilesystem: false` | Writable root filesystem increases attack surface |
| `securityContext` absent/empty | No privilege restrictions enforced |
| `privileged_mode: true` | Cloud-specific equivalent of privileged flag |

---

### 3. Running as Root or Superuser
**Description:** Services, containers, or processes are configured to execute under the root or equivalent superuser account.

| Keywords / Attributes / Fields | Implication |
|---|---|
| `user: root` / `USER root` | Explicitly runs as root |
| `runAsUser: 0` | UID 0 maps to root |
| `runAsNonRoot: false` | Disables enforcement of non-root execution |
| `runAsGroup: 0` | Primary group is root |
| `master_username: root` / `db_user: admin` | Database configured with superuser account |

---

### 4. Excessive Linux Capabilities
**Description:** Linux capabilities beyond the minimum necessary set are added to containers or processes.

| Keywords / Attributes / Fields | Implication |
|---|---|
| `cap_add: ALL` / `capabilities: add: ALL` | Grants every available capability |
| `cap_add: SYS_ADMIN` | Near-root level capability |
| `cap_add: NET_ADMIN` | Full network stack manipulation |
| `cap_add: SYS_PTRACE` | Allows process tracing, memory inspection |
| `drop` section absent | No capability restrictions applied |

---

### 5. Host Namespace Sharing
**Description:** Containers are allowed to share host-level namespaces, granting visibility or control over the underlying host.

| Keywords / Attributes / Fields | Implication |
|---|---|
| `hostPID: true` | Container sees all host processes |
| `hostNetwork: true` | Container bypasses network isolation |
| `hostIPC: true` | Container can access host shared memory |
| `network_mode: host` | Direct host network access |
| `pid_mode: host` | Shares host PID namespace |

---

### 6. Overly Permissive Network / Firewall Rules
**Description:** Security groups or firewall rules allow unrestricted inbound/outbound traffic, amplifying the impact of any privileged process.

| Keywords / Attributes / Fields | Implication |
|---|---|
| `cidr: 0.0.0.0/0` or `::/0` (inbound) | Open to all internet traffic |
| `from_port: 0` + `to_port: 65535` | All ports exposed |
| `protocol: -1` or `protocol: all` | All protocols permitted |
| `ingress` / `inbound` with unrestricted CIDR | Unrestricted ingress rule |

---

### 7. Overly Permissive Storage Access
**Description:** Storage resources are made publicly accessible or lack access controls, compounding the risk when operated under elevated privilege.

| Keywords / Attributes / Fields | Implication |
|---|---|
| `acl: public-read` / `acl: public-read-write` | Bucket/object is world-readable or writable |
| `block_public_acls: false` | Public ACLs not blocked |
| `block_public_policy: false` | Public bucket policies allowed |
| `public_access: true` / `publicly_accessible: true` | Resource exposed to public |

---

### 8. Service Account / Role Binding with Excessive Scope
**Description:** Service accounts or workloads are bound to administrative or cluster-wide roles unnecessarily.

| Keywords / Attributes / Fields | Implication |
|---|---|
| `cluster-admin` (role binding subject) | Full cluster control assigned |
| `clusterrolebinding` with `serviceaccount` subject | Cluster-wide permissions to a workload identity |
| `admin` role bound to broad subjects | Namespace or resource admin unnecessarily granted |
| `automountServiceAccountToken: true` | Token auto-mounted and potentially exploitable |

---

### 9. Unconstrained Sudo / Root Provisioning
**Description:** User data scripts, provisioning steps, or cloud-init configurations grant unrestricted elevated access.

| Keywords / Attributes / Fields | Implication |
|---|---|
| `NOPASSWD: ALL` in sudoers | Passwordless unrestricted sudo |
| `sudo su` / `sudo -i` in user-data | Switches to root without restriction |
| `root_access: true` | Explicit root access grant |
| `user_data` blocks containing `chmod 777` | Overly permissive file access in init |

---

### 10. Secrets and Sensitive Data with Broad Access
**Description:** Credentials, secrets, or sensitive parameters are accessible to more principals than necessary.

| Keywords / Attributes / Fields | Implication |
|---|---|
| `Principal: "*"` in secrets policy | Any identity can access the secret |
| `kms_key_id` absent | Data unencrypted, accessible without key restriction |
| `iam_access` / `resource_policy` with wildcard | Broad access to sensitive parameters |

---

## Summary Table of Key Detection Signals

| Category | High-Risk Signals |
|---|---|
| IAM Policies | `"*"` in actions/resources, `AdministratorAccess` |
| Containers | `privileged: true`, `runAsUser: 0`, `allowPrivilegeEscalation: true` |
| Capabilities | `cap_add: ALL`, `cap_add: SYS_ADMIN` |
| Host Namespaces | `hostPID`, `hostNetwork`, `hostIPC` set to `true` |
| Network Rules | `0.0.0.0/0` inbound, all-port ranges |
| Storage | `public-read-write`, `block_public_acls: false` |
| Role Bindings | `cluster-admin`, service account bound to admin |
| Provisioning | `NOPASSWD: ALL`, `chmod 777`, `root_access: true` |

> **Key Principle:** Any configuration that grants permissions beyond what is strictly necessary for the defined task — whether through identity, process execution context, network exposure, or data access — is a potential indicator of CWE-250 in IaC.

package glitch

import data.glitch_lib

privileged_true_attrs := {
    "privileged", "allowprivilegeescalation", "hostpid", "hostnetwork",
    "hostipc", "privileged_mode", "root_access", "publicly_accessible", "public_access"
}

false_protection_attrs := {
    "runasnonroot", "readonlyrootfilesystem", "block_public_acls", "block_public_policy"
}

root_user_attrs := {"user", "run_as_user", "runasuser", "db_user", "master_username"}

dangerous_capabilities := {"ALL", "SYS_ADMIN", "NET_ADMIN", "SYS_PTRACE", "SYS_MODULE", "SYS_RAWIO"}

overprivileged_policy_values := {"*", "AdministratorAccess", "FullAccess", "PowerUser"}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    lower(attr.name) == privileged_true_attrs[_]
    attr.value.ir_type == "Boolean"
    attr.value.value == true

    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - Privileged or elevated access flag is enabled. (CWE-250)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    lower(attr.name) == false_protection_attrs[_]
    attr.value.ir_type == "Boolean"
    attr.value.value == false

    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - Security protection flag is disabled. (CWE-250)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    regex.match("(?i)^runasuser$|^run_as_user$|^runasgroup$|^run_as_group$", attr.name)
    attr.value.ir_type == "Integer"
    attr.value.value == 0

    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - Container configured to run as root (UID/GID 0). (CWE-250)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    lower(attr.name) == root_user_attrs[_]
    attr.value.ir_type == "String"
    regex.match("(?i)^root$|^admin$", attr.value.value)

    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - Service configured to run as root or admin user. (CWE-250)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    regex.match("(?i)^cap_add$|^add$", attr.name)
    glitch_lib.traverse(attr.value, dangerous_capabilities)

    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - Dangerous Linux capabilities added to container. (CWE-250)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    regex.match("(?i)^actions?$|^resources?$|^managed_policy_arns?$|^policy_arn$", attr.name)
    glitch_lib.traverse(attr.value, overprivileged_policy_values)

    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - Wildcard or overly permissive IAM policy. (CWE-250)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    regex.match("(?i)^principals?$", attr.name)
    attr.value.ir_type == "String"
    attr.value.value == "*"

    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - Wildcard principal grants access to any identity. (CWE-250)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    lower(attr.name) == "acl"
    attr.value.ir_type == "String"
    regex.match("(?i)public", attr.value.value)

    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - Storage resource configured with public ACL. (CWE-250)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    attr.value.ir_type == "String"
    regex.match("(?i)NOPASSWD.*ALL|sudo\\s+-i|sudo\\s+su\\b|chmod\\s+777", attr.value.value)

    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - Unrestricted sudo or overly permissive provisioning in script. (CWE-250)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    regex.match("(?i)^role_?ref$|^role_?name$|^rolename$", attr.name)
    attr.value.ir_type == "String"
    regex.match("(?i)cluster-admin|^admin$", attr.value.value)

    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - Service account bound to admin or cluster-admin role. (CWE-250)"
    }
}
